title: Miffy goes to the seaside.
lines: This is Miffy.
Miffy is a little white bunny, with two long ears and a little cross for a mouth.
On a sunny day Father says: Miffy, it's so warm today.
Do you know what we're going to do?
We're going to the seaside!
Hooray!
shouts Miffy, and she jumps around.
Hop, hop, hop!
Mother packs a big bag.
A towel, sun cream, a bottle of water, cheese sandwiches and an apple.
And Miffy takes her bucket and spade.
A red bucket and a yellow spade.
They go to the seaside by train.
Choo, choo, choo.
Miffy looks out of the window.
She sees cows, and sheep, and windmills.
And then, in the distance, she sees something blue and sparkly.
The sea!
On the beach the sand is warm under her feet.
Ow, ow, hot!
Miffy runs quickly to the water.
The waves come rolling in.
Whoosh!
And then they roll back out again.
Miffy jumps over the little waves.
Hee hee hee!
The water is cold and it tickles her feet.
Then Miffy builds a sandcastle.
She scoops sand into her bucket.
She pats it with her spade.
Pat, pat.
Then she turns the bucket upside down.
A tower!
And another tower, and another.
Father digs a moat around it.
Mother looks for shells to decorate the castle.
White shells, pink shells and a big striped shell.
What a beautiful castle!
But then a big wave comes.
Whoooosh!
The water runs into the moat.
Look, says Miffy, now my castle has a real moat full of water!
Then Miffy sees something moving in the sand.
It's a little crab!
The little crab walks in a very funny way, sideways, sideways, sideways.
Hello, little crab, says Miffy.
The crab waves its claws and walks back to the water.
At lunchtime they eat their sandwiches on the towel.
And for pudding Miffy gets an ice cream.
A strawberry ice cream with a wafer.
Mmm, yummy!
At the end of the day Miffy is tired.
Her ears droop a little.
She waves to the sea.
Bye, sea!
See you next time!
On the train home she falls asleep, with a shell in her paw.
What a lovely day it was.
